description: Retrieve the stored memory count for a single logical namespace alongside rolling 30-day organization quota metrics (read-only, idempotent; consumes 1 Read API call) and return { namespace, memory_count, used_calls_30d, api_call_limit }. Rejects reserved "org:" prefixes on namespace. Use when inspecting how many memories exist inside one specific project or wing namespace; use health instead for an organization-wide connectivity and total-memory check, or list_agent_wings for per-wing counts.

namespace.description: Logical workspace namespace to inspect (for example "my-project" or "wing:qa").

name: stats

api_call_limit.description: Rolling 30-day API call quota, or null for unlimited.

memory_count.description: Number of memories stored in this namespace.

used_calls_30d.description: Rolling 30-day API calls used by the organization.

title: Get Namespace Statistics
